subject: v155 per-item 异质曲率 c_l,i via PrefixRouter (L1/L2), v133 baseline 上加 per-item 路由

mechanism.type: per-item heterogeneous curvature via prefix-conditioned router
mechanism.implementation: PrefixRouter.fc2 输出 delta, c_l,i = C_MIN + (C_MAX-C_MIN)*sigmoid(theta_l + delta_l,i)
mechanism.scope: L1/L2 only (L0 仍用全局 c, 防 cascade norm 风险)

r36p_trigger.r36p_diagnostic: per-item router 让相似 item 共享相近 c, 反而加速 codebook collapse. v53 A1 的根因 (router 几步饱和) 没被 delta_max=0.3 充分限制, 因为 per-item 维度的 c 调制让 codebook 几何形态被严重压缩
